# Pull request

## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the issue with `Closes #...` when the work completes it.

## Validation

Record the relevant check, build or playtest results. Documentation-only changes need the repository checks. A release change also needs versioned gate evidence.

## Review

- [ ] Acceptance criteria met and dependencies addressed.
- [ ] Relevant design, decision record and changelog updated.
- [ ] Code and assets have the required permissions.
- [ ] Material limitations and rollback considerations documented.
